one_liner: Focus timer where a tree grows while you stay off your phone
audience: students in exam season, remote workers and knowledge workers with Slack and feeds one tab away, and adults with ADHD who struggle with executive function and delayed rewards; skews late teens to mid thirties (inferred)
core_pain: Losing hours a day to doomscrolling and app switching, then reaching evening feeling the day was wasted, with no visible record of where the time went
old_way_objects: putting the phone face down across the room
scenes: Student at a library desk during exam crunch, revision notes open, picking up the phone 'for one second' and losing forty minutes to TikTok
Remote worker at a kitchen table, Slack in one tab, opening Instagram mid-task and forgetting what they were doing
Couple at dinner or a parent with kids on the sofa, both phones face up, nobody actually talking
proof_points: 1M+ user ratings across App Store and Google Play
App Store Best of the Year & Best New Apps
Google Play Best of the Year
2,102,946 real trees planted through nonprofit partner Trees for the Future
Real trees planted across Kenya, Senegal, Tanzania, Uganda and Cameroon
Forest covers the tree planting cost from app revenue
Featured by The New York Times, Business Insider, Mashable, TechRadar, Common Sense Media, ADDitude
New York Times quote: 'Forest works well, and if your goal is to be more in the moment, ignore your phone and actually talk to your friends when you are with them, this is the app for you.'
App blocking (Deep Focus), Plant Together and the tree-planting mechanic are free, no expiration
Cross-platform sync across iPhone, iPad, Android and browser
Plus adds custom app allowlist, full analytics, all soundscapes, 3x coin boost, plant up to 5 real trees per account
do_not_say: Do not say Forest treats, cures or manages ADHD, or call it a medical or therapeutic tool
Do not say it cures phone addiction
Do not promise productivity gains, hours saved or grade improvements with invented numbers
Do not use hustle or shame language: 'crush your goals', 'no excuses', 'lazy', 'you're wasting your life'
Do not name rival focus or blocker apps
Do not imply every user personally plants a real tree without mentioning coins and the plan limits
Do not claim the tree planting count beyond the stated 2 million plus figure
Do not say Plus is required for app blocking
cta: Download Forest and start a free focus session (free tier, no credit card)
